proposals.title: Give Each Share An Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a recapitalization plan giving each share one vote, eliminating the Ford family's 16-votes-per-share dual-class structure within two years.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 5 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing Ford's direct and indirect lobbying, grassroots lobbying communications, trade association payments, and board oversight of them.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 6 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.
